invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: The cancellation link is incomplete. Open the link from your confirmation email or text exactly as it was sent, or ask the host to take you off the list.

confirm.title: Cancel your RSVP?
confirm.body: This takes you off the guest list for the event in your confirmation message and lets the host know. You will stop getting updates about it.

done.title: Your RSVP is cancelled
done.body: You are off the guest list and the host has been told. You can RSVP again any time from the event page.

error.title: We couldn't cancel that RSVP
error.fallback: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.notFound: We couldn't find that RSVP. The link may have expired, or the event may be over.
error.validation: This cancellation link looks incorrect or has expired.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.network: We couldn't reach civfix to cancel this RSVP. Check your connection and try again.
